Shadow Tactics maintains a focus on structure and texture—beats splinter, surfaces scrape, and each element is placed with intent. It’s a concise study in mechanical detail and broken rhythm, placing WONKS in conversation with artists like Richard Devine , Funckarma , Hecq , and Funkstörung . Core tension lies in its restraint There’s a fidgety, percussive charge running through WONKS ’ Shadow Tactics , a set of four tightly engineered pieces that probe the mechanics of funk from the inside out.
